name: Ziba
overview: The account of Ziba in 2 Samuel 9 highlights his role as a faithful servant to both Mephibosheth and King David. When David sought to show kindness to any remaining member of Saul’s house for Jonathan’s sake, Ziba identified Mephibosheth, Jonathan’s lame son, and provided information about his whereabouts. This demonstrates Ziba’s fidelity to Mephibosheth and his faithfulness to David’s desire to extend God’s kindness to Saul’s family. Ziba’s cooperation enabled David to honor his covenant with Jonathan by restoring Mephibosheth to his rightful place.
